title: v1_143 / Release highlights
content: ## Release highlights This release makes the Copilot harness the default for new sessions and adds tools to compare models, reclaim storage, run models locally, and navigate file changes. * [Copilot harness by default](#copilot-harness-as-the-default): The default for new sessions, built on the Copilot SDK, lets you switch between editor and Agents window. * [Compare models (Preview)](#compare-model-results-preview): Run the same task with multiple models in the Agents window, then compare and combine their solutions. * [Reclaim worktree storage (Experimental)](#reclaim-storage-from-inactive-worktrees-experimental): Free disk space by reviewing and removing inactive agent session worktrees. * [On-device models (Experimental)](#run-copilot-models-on-your-device-experimental): Run MAI Code 1.1 Flash locally on your device for your agent tasks. * [Multi-diff file list (Experimental)](#multi-file-diff-editor-file-list-experimental): Keep an overview of and jump between changed files in the multi-file diff editor.
